<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex87012023-10-04-131522" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Closing verses (151b7-152a3)"/>
    <lg><l><lb n="151b7"/> bdag nyid chen po'i gzhung don ji bzhin 'chad pas gzhan gyi the tshom gcod ||</l> <l>rang rgyud thal 'gyur gtan tshigs rnam par dag pas nus pa shin du che ||</l> 
    <l>tshig don legs par 'phrod cing snga phyi 'brel pas 'jug ngogs shin du bde' ||</l> 
    <l>de ltar chos gsum tshang ba legs par bshad pa bstan pa'i 'od zer yin ||</l> </lg>
   <lg> <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3747">mi 'pham mgon</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3720">klu <choice><orig>las</orig><reg>la</reg></choice> dbang bsgyur</rs> dang ||</l> 
    <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3771">phyogs <lb n="151b8"/> las rgyal</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3773"><rs type="work">rnam 'grel</rs> mdzad pa</rs> ste ||</l> 
    <l>kun kyi legs bshad 'dzin pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4018">chu mig pa</rs>s ||</l> 
    <l><rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6173">chen po'i pho brang dge ba'i gnas</rs> su sbyar ||</l> </lg>
    <lg><l>legs bshad bstan pa'i 'od zer kun du 'phros pas 'gro ba thams cad kyang ||</l> 
    <l>nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa'i mun pa stug po rab bcom ste ||</l> 
    <l>ji ltar ji snyed shes bya'i don kun <pb n="152a"/><lb n="152a1"/> blo yi mig gis legs mthong nas ||</l> 
    <l>spangs dang rtogs pa'i rang bzhin byang chub chen po'i go 'phang thob par shog ||</l> </lg>
  <lg>  <l><rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:5559">gangs can</rs> 'dir 'ongs gzhung °° lugs 'di 'chad 'di yi don ||</l> 
    <l>legs par bshad dang ma bshad log <lb n="152a2"/> par bshad pa'i don ||</l> 
    <l>thams cad len 'chad 'dor la 'gal zlos med phyir 'di ||</l> 
    <l>blo ldan legs bshad don gnyer kun gyis blang bar rigs ||</l> </lg>
  <lg>  <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3773">dpal ldan grags pa</rs>'i gzhung don blta bar 'dod pa gzhan gyi blo ||</l> 
    <l>sprin tshogs stug pos bsgribs pa'i mkha' la nyi ma blta ba bzhin |</l>
    <l><lb n="152a3"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4018">bdag</rs> gi blo gros dri ma med pa nam mkha' yangs pa'i dbus ||</l> 
    <l>rnam par nges don <choice><reg>nyi ma</reg><orig>ny°°</orig></choice>'i dkyil 'khor skyon med rab tu gsal || ||</l></lg></seg></TEI>
